english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is enough or adequate.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something being sufficient or meeting a requirement.

examples.english: Is this money sufficient to buy a ticket?
examples.traditional: 呢啲錢夠唔夠買張飛呀？
